name: The Tome of Divinity

narrative.details:
I c'n see me wife's o'er there beamin' wit pride already. Ya better get yer tuchus o'er there pronto. I be thinkin' she'd have some words wit ya.

Light be witcha, mighty champion. I'll be lookin' fer ya on the battlefield against the Scourge and dem Dark Irons when the time comes.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done all of Ironforge a great favor today, adventurer. I'm proud to count you among us, and if you feel you're ready, I would like to bless you with this scroll. The Symbol of Life would only have worked when used by a Champion who was ready for one of the Light's greatest blessings-the power to restore the dead back to life.

I will teach you the ability to resurrect your companions. Use it wisely, adventurer, and thank you, on behalf of myself, my husband, and Ironforge.
